summary: Reads fields at this+0x20, this+0x24, this+0x28 and writes each to its corresponding output pointer (a2, a3, a4) when non-null; returns a4.

local_names.this: object pointer; base for the three read fields
local_names.a2: output pointer receiving field at this+0x20
local_names.a3: output pointer receiving field at this+0x24
local_names.a4: output pointer receiving field at this+0x28; also the return value

operations.description: Proceed with the first write only if a2 is non-null.
Proceed with the second write only if a3 is non-null.
Proceed with the third write only if a4 is non-null.

unresolved: Semantic meaning of the three read fields (0x20, 0x24, 0x28) and of the returned pointer a4 is unknown; owning object type is unknown.
